title: 第3064章 让血魔教名扬虚空第3063章 自创无上诡术血祖囚界印
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
“这……”
“我们不受控制了？”
风祖，蛮帝，兵祖等强者都大惊失色。
他们此生从未见过此等霸道的控制手段，意识清醒，但根本控制不了自己的行为。
对方只要一声令下，他们的身体就会做出本能的反应，完美的去执行主人的命令。
甚至让他们去死，他们都不会有半点犹豫。
偏偏意识如同第三者视角一样去旁观自己，什么也改变不了，这种情况太叫人绝望了。
而且他们产生不了任何自杀的想法。
天音祖师花容失色，因为六大高手里面，只有她一个是女人，女人被如此邪恶的强者控制的下场，她简直不敢想。
反观符祖则是最为淡定，自己都是老头子一个了，又不是美女，自然不必担心，只需要担心今后别被当成炮灰，别杀自家人就行。
洛凡尘淡淡的瞥了一眼天音祖师：
“放心，本祖美女见多了，对你兴致不大。”
惊恐担忧的天音祖师闻言倒是不慌了，但是自尊心被刺痛了。
她可是位列大道共济会第十六把交椅的高手啊，气质出众，竟然如此被一个邪恶的家伙看不起？
只不过一想到对方那可怕的实力，也就紧紧的闭上了嘴巴，不敢多言。
洛凡尘扭转头颅，看向卜天君，还有兵祖等强者：“对女人不感兴趣，本祖对男人的兴趣倒是很浓厚啊。”
“什么？”
兵祖等人汗毛竖起，害怕极了。
死他们都不怕，但血魔古祖这么一句话，让他们恨不得自己原地暴毙。
洛凡尘挪动脚步，绕到了他们的背后。

“不！”
蛮帝，兵祖等强者差点哭出声来。
天音祖师劝说道：“你们别怕，这血魔古祖无非就是陪你们玩耍一下，又不会杀了你们。”
兵祖瞪圆眼珠子：“血魔古祖收拾的不是你是吧？”
这个时候，洛凡尘已经绕到了天音祖师的背后：“诶嘿嘿。”
“再没有遇到我喜欢的女人之前，我一直以为自己是喜欢男人的。”
“这天音祖师看起来不错啊！”
天音祖师肌肤一紧，发出惊呼之声。
这个时候轮到符祖等人幸灾乐祸：“别怕！”
“血魔古祖会很温柔的。”
“他只是想要你，又不是想要你的命，你害怕什么啊？”
天音祖师死死咬住嘴唇，要骂人了。
content_en:
"This..."
"Are we out of control?"
Feng Ancestor, Barbarian Emperor, Bing Ancestor and other powerful men were all shocked.
They have never seen such overbearing control methods in their lives. They are conscious, but they cannot control their behavior at all.
As long as the other party gives an order, their bodies will react instinctively and execute the master's order perfectly.
Even if they were asked to die, they would not hesitate at all.
However, the consciousness is observing oneself from the perspective of a third person, and nothing can be changed. This situation is so despairing.
And they are unable to have any suicidal thoughts.
Patriarch Tianyin's beauty turned pale because she was the only one among the six masters who was a woman. She simply could not imagine the fate of a woman being controlled by such an evil strong man.
On the other hand, Fu Zu is the calmest. He is an old man and not a beautiful woman, so there is no need to worry. He only needs to worry about not being used as cannon fodder in the future and not killing his family.
Luo Fanchen glanced at Patriarch Tianyin lightly:
"Don't worry, I've seen too many beauties and I'm not very interested in you."
The frightened and worried Patriarch Tianyin did not panic after hearing this, but his pride was stung.
She is a master who ranks sixteenth in the Grand Avenue Freemasonry. She has an outstanding temperament, but she is so looked down upon by an evil guy?
But when he thought of the other party's terrifying strength, he shut his mouth tightly and did not dare to say anything.
Luo Fanchen turned his head and looked at Bu Tianjun, Bingzu and other powerful men: "I am not interested in women, but I am very interested in men."
"What?"
Bing Zu and others' hair stood on end, terrified.
They were not afraid of death, but the words of the Blood Demon Ancestor made them wish they could die suddenly on the spot.
Luo Fanchen moved his steps and walked around behind them.
"No!"
The Barbarian Emperor, the Soldier Ancestor and other powerful men almost cried.
Patriarch Tianyin advised: "Don't be afraid, this ancient blood demon just wants to play with you, and he won't kill you."
Ancestor Bing's eyes widened: "It's not you the Ancient Blood Demon Ancestor is dealing with, right?"
At this time, Luo Fanchen had already walked around behind Patriarch Tianyin: "Hey, hehe."
"Before I met a woman I liked, I always thought I liked men."
"This Patriarch Tianyin looks good!"
Patriarch Tianyin’s skin tightened and he exclaimed.
At this time, it was Fu Zu and others' turn to gloat: "Don't be afraid!"
"Ancestor Blood Demon will be very gentle."
"He just wants you, but he doesn't want your life. What are you afraid of?"
Patriarch Tianyin bit his lip and was about to curse.
